mapper.select: SELECT ar.route_id, ar.dept_id, ar.step_number, ar.approver_user_id, d.dept_name, u.user_name AS approver_user_name FROM approval_routes ar INNER JOIN departments d ON ar.dept_id = d.dept_id INNER JOIN users u ON ar.approver_user_id = u.user_id WHERE ar.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY ar.step_number

SELECT ar.route_id, ar.dept_id, ar.step_number, ar.approver_user_id, d.dept_name, u.user_name AS approver_user_name FROM approval_routes ar INNER JOIN departments d ON ar.dept_id = d.dept_id INNER JOIN users u ON ar.approver_user_id = u.user_id WHERE ar.dept_id = #{deptId} AND ar.step_number = ( SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM approval_histories ah WHERE ah.expense_id = #{expenseId} AND ah.action IN ('APPROVE', 'REJECT') )
